concerns.text: The plan downloads the Materials Project bulk archive from a Zenodo release (e.g., https://zenodo.org/record/1234567/files/mp_bulk_data.zip). Constitution VI mandates that raw magnetic‑property data be obtained exclusively via the Materials Project REST API, not via a bulk Zenodo archive.

Training logs are recorded only in a generic `logs/training.log`. Constitution VII requires a complete `training_log.json` containing seeds, hyper‑parameter grid, and exact train‑test split indices to reside in `code/`. The current task description does not produce this required artifact.
